 Home News Local News What to Know About Medicare as Open Enrollment Begins What to Know About Medicare as Open Enrollment Begins
 Wed, October 21, 2026 by Reid Kamhi 
 SHARE NOW 
 The open enrollment period for Medicare is now open, and healthcare providers and pharmacies alike are hoping to educate the public on the many options available. The timeframe began last Thursday and runs through December 7. Available plans’ details may change from year to year, as can beneficiaries’ personal health situations. Speaking on the WTIM Shelbyville Morning Show, Jessie Reed from Family Drug says Medicare’s online system will suggest plans based on health factors, medications, and more.
 https://tdn-435957167126-us-east-2-an.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026/10/Reed-1-2026.10.19.mp3 
 Reed says Family Drug will help local Medicare beneficiaries through that process. Those interested can schedule an appointment with the pharmacy.
 https://tdn-435957167126-us-east-2-an.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026/10/Reed-2-2026.10.19.mp3 
 Prices and deductibles have increased for this year by the largest amount in three years due to certain Medicare subsidies expiring.
 https://tdn-435957167126-us-east-2-an.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026/10/Reed-3-2026.10.19.mp3 
 Reed also notes that Medicare will cover several well-known weight-loss drugs at the turn of the year in certain cases.
 https://tdn-435957167126-us-east-2-an.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026/10/Reed-4-2026.10.19.mp3 
 More information on Medicare is available at Medicare.gov . Family Drug can be reached by calling (217) 774-7838.
